title: Sindh Peoples Local Government Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Peoples Local Government Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1973
ACT VI OF 1973
SIND PEOPLE'S
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the Sind People's Local Government ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary. Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-6/73.--The
Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1973, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 6th June 1973, and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th Jane 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Act may be called the Sind People's Local Government
(Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Peoples Local Government Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Amendment of section 100 of Sind Ordinance II of 1972

ACT VI OF 1973
ACT VI OF 1973
SIND PEOPLE'S
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the Sind People's Local Government ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary. Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-6/73.--The
Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1973, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 6th June 1973, and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th Jane 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
2. Amendment of section 100 of
Sind Ordinance II of 1972.--In the Sind People's Local Government
Ordinance, 1972 hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 100,
in subsection (1), for the words "a fine which may extend to five hundred
rupees", the words "imprisonment of either description for a term
which may extend to three months or with fine which may extend to one thousand
rupees or with both" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Peoples Local Government Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Amendment of Schedule X to Sind Ordinance II of 1972

ACT VI OF 1973
ACT VI OF 1973
SIND PEOPLE'S
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the Sind People's Local Government ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary. Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-6/73.--The
Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1973, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 6th June 1973, and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th Jane 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
3. Amendment of Schedule X to
Sind Ordinance II of 1972.--In Schedule X to the said Ordinance, after
entry 35, the following new entries shall be added, namely :-
"35-A.
Writing or painting of any objectionable, abusive, provocative or such other
slogans or words on a building.
35-B. Failure to
remove or erase bills, notices, placards, papers, writings or paintings
referred to in entries 35 and 35-A by the owner or occupier of the
building."
